# C5: AI runtime

Agents are defined as data: what they read, what they may write, the model and budget. Every run gets a context pack (the data it may see, wrapped and labelled as data, never instructions, with its classification), and leaves a run summary. Recordings let any run be replayed without a model, which is how tests run.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version        | Value |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Schema version | 1     |

| `id`              | string (RecordId)                             | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id. |

| `inputs`          | enum (ChangeArtifact) or enum (AgentInput)[]  | yes      | `brief`, `proposal`, `specs`, `interfaces`, `mappings`, `data`, `design`, `ux`, `stories`, `tasks`, `snow`, `catalog-slice`, `checklist`, `skills`, `patterns`, `glossary`, `repo-code`, `documents` |                                                                                                                                                              |

| `allowedRuntimes` | enum (RuntimeKind)[]                          | yes      | `hand-off`, `model`, `headless-claude-code`, `mock`, `replay`                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                              |
